annotations.exact_quote: This paper presents an improved multi-label classification method based on local label constraints and classifier chains for solving multi-label tasks with large number of labels.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文明确提出改进的多标签分类方法并用于解决多标签任务，属于学习为实例预测多个同时成立标记的任务。

annotations.exact_quote: local tree-structure constraints among different labels are mined based on mutual information metric
annotations.reason_zh: 论文显式挖掘不同标签之间的局部树结构约束与依赖，并基于互信息建模标签相关性。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要提到 classifier chain，但未明确说明结合多个分类器预测或按样本分配专家，无法确认满足分类器集成定义。
